claims.claim: VideoSeek achieves 68.4% on LVBench w/o subtitles with 92.3 frames, outperforming base GPT-5 by +8.3% while consuming 76% fewer frames.
With subtitles on LVBench, VideoSeek reaches 76.7% with only 27.2 frames, surpassing DVD (76.0% with 8,074 frames).
On LongVideoBench, VideoSeek scores 73.5% with 29.6 frames, beating DVD by +4.9% and base GPT-5 by +9.0%.
On Video-Holmes causal benchmark, VideoSeek leads all models with 47.3% overall accuracy using only 42.7 frames.
A non-thinking backbone (GPT-4.1) collapses to 53.0% (-15.4%) due to premature over-confident stopping after only 2.99 turns.
